messages:
erin.sre: Posted the RCA for the 05/05 model-fallback thrash: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1865432100-fallback-thrash-rca. Short: flaky network to a regional cache caused repeated fallback churn, increasing latency and retry storms for ~30m.
erin.sre: No customer data affected, but impact included elevated p50/p95 and a handful of timed-out requests. I summarized the root cause + immediate mitigations up top.
support-bot: New doc created by erin.sre: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1865432100-fallback-thrash-rca :robot_face:
leon.prod: Thanks Erin. I've added an "Executive Summary" blurb for the leadership note and an outreach checklist for affected customers. @support-bot can you add the customer list to Appendix A?
support-bot: Appended affected-tenants.csv to the doc (redacted).
maya.eng: I'll pick up the retry-backoff config change and run the canary. Plan: increase base backoff 100ms -> 300ms and cap retries to 3. PR will be posted tonight.
henry.ops: I'll own the network mitigation: tighten healthcheck thresholds for the cache layer to avoid flapping, and add a suppressor during scheduled maintenance. ETA: tomorrow AM.
erin.sre: Action items (copied here):
1) Update retry/backoff policy (owner: @maya.eng)  due: today 23:59 PT
2) Cache healthcheck + suppressor changes (owner: @henry.ops)  due: tomorrow 10:00 PT
3) Customer outreach draft + approval (owner: @leon.prod + support)  due: tomorrow 14:00 PT
4) Add forensic log slice and retention tags for the incident (owner: @erin.sre + infra)  due: Fri 09:00 PT
5) Postmortem test: simulate cache-network flaps in staging (owner: @maya.eng)  due: Wed COB
leon.prod: Proposing a 25-min sync Thu 11:30 PT to confirm items 1-3 closed. React with :thumbsup: if you can.
maya.eng: Thu 11:30 works for me.
henry.ops: +1
erin.sre: Calendar invite created: "Follow-up: 05/05 fallback thrash RCA" Thu 11:30 PT  https://calendar.redwood/ev/1865432100-followup
leon.prod: I'll draft the exec note after A1-A3 are done, and include a short risk/cost appendix for retry changes.
erin.sre: Thanks all. I'll update the doc with PR links and mark items as in-progress. Ping me if you need the raw logs. :white_check_mark:
